'''Wicket33 Ewoks 3.11 for Strike Teams''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Wicket33]]
* '''Published:''' 6 June 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rebel Strike Team|Endor-L-rebelstriketeam.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Rebel Strike Team
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed RST Wicket33 LS 2002 Ewoks311.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is the Ewok deck from before with new twists. Thanks for the other reviews, they helped.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

The deck uses Ewoks, which in my previous deck have done well in battle. In a tournament last week, Paploo defeated Maul with Saber without any interrupt or weapon assistance. My main goal is to destroy the bunker. My primary strike team is Han, Chewie, Beezer, Wicket, and a tribesman. Two charges is more than enough to pull the job off. The Free Ride combo card is for Cloud City Occupation, a popular deck in my area. I pull it with Paploo, a scout by the way, and either cancel an occupation or peek at my opponents hand. The tribesman look dumb at first, but when I started playing this deck, I lost to beatdown squads by huge attrition. I use the tribesman because they slurp up all attrition while with my main ewoks. Since I put them in, I have rarely had a battle on Endor ground. Thanks for reading and any feedback is appreciated.
